images.seen: Cliopatria draws only Sumerian city-states, Egypt and Indus; compiled map adds the dossier cultures. Nothing far outside its region; Hubei (Qujialing) empty after 2500.

First Dynasty of Ur drawn over the whole Sumer admin-1 block (379 free cells in Al-Muthannia, An-Najaf, Basra desert), far wider than Cliopatria's alluvial outline; Umma's 30 km disk shown in the collective's colour with one cell of its own.
Lagash drawn as a 497-cell empire over the same desert block; Mari core drawn as Lagash vassal tint; Elam and Ur hatched occupations look as the dossiers intend.
Mari: teal Euphrates strip plus a lavender (Lagash-tint vassal) 100 km disk around the city; consistent with lagash/ledger/4.
Old Kingdom of Egypt equals Cliopatria; Kerma is a plain 200 km disc in the desert (placeholder named in its dossier).
After the patch Ur holds the alluvium around Lagash and Umma only; desert empty.
After the patch Umma (11 cells), Lagash (22) and Ur (19) show as three city-states inside the Sumerian collective.

issues.what: first-dynasty-of-ur_-2500 (and lagash_-2450) draw the hegemony over the gazetteer's whole Sumer admin-1 block, 379 free desert cells that neither Cliopatria nor the Sumer page assign to anyone; the cascade then gave Lagash 497 cells (-2450) and the collective 513 cells (-2425) and 640 at -2400 against Cliopatria's 419-cell outline.

Umma owned one cell: its 30 km disk (11 cells) stayed with the collective because Umma's found has no counterpart and the R2 succession rule (successor sumerian-city-states) wins in its life; the Lagash split is booked, Umma's was not.

Lagash lost all its land at -2425: sumerian-city-states/ledger/7 takes 'Sumer minus Umma and Ur', a region that includes Lagash's own disk, and nothing returns it although Lagash lives to -2340 (Entemena, Urukagina).
Qujialing ends at -2500 with successor shijiahe-culture, which has no dossier: 916 cells of Hubei go to nobody for the rest of the Shijiahe span (2500-2000 BC).

Remaining snaps: sumerian-city-states_-2500 adds 30 cells (Sala ad-Din, Diyala, Wasit); lagash_-2425 and first-dynasty-of-ur_-2450 are down to 0 and 2 cells. Conflicts left are the size rule on 7 Ilam cells (elam won) and R2 cells of kish/sumerian-city-states.
Kingdom of Kerma is a plain 200 km circle (437 cells) around Kerma; the dossier says the page gives the seat and 'Upper Nubia' but no border.
Hoabinhian (7063 cells) is a union of Vietnam, Laos, Thailand, Cambodia, Myanmar and the Malay Peninsula held for 4000 years; the dossier calls it a coarse placement.
Lagash's tribute-vassalage of a 100 km disk around Mari (65 cells, -2450..-2426) rests on 'demanded tribute as far as Mari'; I did not open a page for it.
Small oddities not worth a patch: Kish's Akkad region has a detached 20-cell lobe west of the Euphrates (Karbala/Najaf side), and two or three isolated Elam cells north-east of Ilam.

colour_clashes.note: Both #da7d9b. They do not touch in the window (the collective lies between) but both sit beside the collective and Lagash, and Lagash occupies Kish's land while Umma is Lagash's vassal.
#008c8c and #00b5b5, two teals; no shared border in this window, so only a legend risk.

dossier_requests.what: New dossier for the Shijiahe culture, 2500-2000 BC, middle Yangtze (Jianghan Plain, Hubei), succeeding qujialing-culture (whose dossier already names it as successor and dissolves into it at -2500).
dossier_requests.why: Without it 916 cells of Hubei are nobody's from -2500 to -2000.

problems: Seam: the patch changes 411 cells of the end anchor m2400 (desert cells no longer held, Lagash 3 -> 22, Umma 1 -> 11, sumerian-city-states 640 -> 232 at -2400). The m2400-m2301 agent starts from that anchor; first-dynasty-of-ur_-2450 and lagash_-2425 run on into that window and are not overridden.

Rule order: the R2 succession rule lets a later successor win its predecessor's land during the predecessor's life (umma, kish name sumerian-city-states as successor; 10 and 8 cells at -2500); rulings cannot overturn R2, so I used a split event for Umma. Consider whether R2 should require the successor's life to start after the predecessor's end.

events/1 carries month 12 because an event without a month ran before sumerian-city-states/ledger/7 (same year, other dossier) and took nothing; if the compiler's ordering changes, re-check Lagash at -2425.
Page budget: 5 of 8 used; Egypt, Indus and the Chinese and American cultures were compared with Cliopatria and the packet only, not with new pages.
